{{Quote|Our Master told us you would come."<br />"Where is he?"<br />"He is inside, entertaining your friends. Unfortunately, you were not invited.|A Dark Acolyte and Mace Windu|<ref name="SW:TCW" />}}
The '''Dark Acolyte Trio''' was a group of [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|Dark Acolytes]] serving [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] in the [[Standard month/Legends|months]] leading up to the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Battle of Geonosis]]. During the Battle of [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]], the Dark Acolytes defended [[Dooku's hangar/Legends|Dooku's hangar]] with [[Sith Enforcer]]s. Piloting a [[TX-130 Saber-class fighter tank/Legends|TX-130 ''Saber''-class fighter tank]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] killed the three Dark Acolytes in a [[Hovertank/Legends|hovertank]] battle outside the [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]].
